## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive; mixed signals with fear easing but rising credit stress. VXX (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND confirms lower fear while HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND implies credit stress rising.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?
Credit stress RISING: HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND. Fear DECREASING: VXX (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND and Gold strength GLD (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND add a safe‑asset bid.

3. Financial Conditions Signal?
Neutral-to-mildly hawkish: UUP (1W: +0.39% | 1M: -0.67%) RECOVERY while TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND signals higher yields. SPY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT supports equities vs bonds (SPY/TLT ↑ rising), adding to the mixed read.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?
Energy leading: XLE (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ABOVE TREND; Tech constructive but less dominant: XLK (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.85%) ABOVE TREND. Financials showing short-term rotation risk: XLF (1W: -0.14% | 1M: +3.10%) CORRECTION — style mixed with cyclical pockets outperforming staples.

5. US vs Global?
US steady: SPY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND; EM improving: EEM (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +1.20%) ABOVE TREND while China soft on the week: FXI (1W: -2.36% | 1M: +4.32%) CORRECTION. Japan showing relative strength in the global mix (Japan vs US ↑ rising).

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculative flows recovered: ARKK (1W: +6.81% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +0.98% | 1M: +2.78%) ABOVE TREND signal risk tolerance; crypto weak: IBIT (1W: -2.31% | 1M: -1.89%) BELOW TREND. Speculation Index (1W: +6.90% | 1M: -0.12%) RECOVERY supports selective risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?
Precious metals strong: GLD (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%) ABOVE TREND. Base metals mixed with copper in CORRECTION: CPER (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION—watch industrial signals.

8. Energy Trend?
Energy very strong: XLE (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.69% | 1M: +7.25%) ABOVE TREND. Nat gas recovering: UNG (1W: +4.72% | 1M: -3.04%) RECOVERY — constructive for energy commodity exposure.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed: Broad sector breadth (7/11) and falling VXX support a lower-fear backdrop; CONFIRMED: SPY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND. Divergence: credit measures (HYG vs LQD) and specific 1W/1M mismatches (XLF, FXI, CPER) are MINOR divergences to monitor.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals in pockets of strength (XLE, XBI) and selective tech exposure (XLK) while monitoring credit signals; reduce exposure to duration: TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND. Watch China/EM idiosyncrasies (FXI CORRECTION) and gold as a hedge.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?
BULLISH: XLE (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ABOVE TREND and XBI (1W: +4.17% | 1M: +2.53%) ABOVE TREND if energy and biotech momentum continue. BEARISH: XLC (1W: -1.58% | 1M: -1.18%) BELOW TREND and XLP (Consumer Staples 1W: -4.31% | 1M: -0.83%) showing weakness if risk tone softens.

12. Commodities to Watch?
BULLISH: GLD (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND and SLV (1W: +5.33% | 1M: +11.08%) ABOVE TREND on safe‑haven and industrial demand. BEARISH/RISK: CPER (1W: -2.03% | 1M: +3.84%) CORRECTION — watch for further pullback or renewed industrial buying.

13. Key Levels?
VXX 20 (VXX (1W: -5.17% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND) as complacency/watch level; SPY/TLT 9.4080 (SPY (1W: +0.35% | 1M: +2.75%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -1.07% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND) for stocks vs bonds. Tech/Financials ratio 3.2607 (XLK (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.85%) ABOVE TREND) and HYG vs LQD divergence (HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND; LQD (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL: Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Energy (XLE (1W: +6.49% | 1M: +7.16%) ABOVE TREND), Tech (XLK (1W: +1.59% | 1M: +2.85%) ABOVE TREND) and metals (GLD (1W: +3.92% | 1M: +8.81%) ABOVE TREND) are showing strength. Key risk is rising credit stress (HYG (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +0.40%) ABOVE TREND vs LQD (1W: -0.58% | 1M: -0.59%) BELOW TREND) alongside SPY/TLT dynamics to monitor.
